name: phpdot/tracelog
description: Channel-based log backend: handlers, formatters, and fail-closed record encryption.

suggest.phpdot/container: The #[Singleton]/#[Config]/#[Binds] attributes in src stay inert until a phpdot application reflects them, so standalone consumers do not need it installed.
suggest.phpdot/console: Enables the tracelog:key:generate and tracelog:check commands (the classes stay inert until something loads them, so standalone consumers do not need it installed).
suggest.phpdot/logs: tracelog:check names the engine NullWriter binding when the application discards records (the class-string check never autoloads it).
suggest.psr/container: tracelog:check reads the WriterInterface binding from the running application container.
suggest.symfony/console: The tracelog:key:generate and tracelog:check commands are Symfony console commands; the classes stay inert until a console loads them.
